The nucleolus is recomputed by successive exact rational least-core programs on every canonical class; the two divergent canonical games also have direct core/least-core certificates. The exact counts, orbit sizes, weighted realizations, dummy-free refinement, and three-player nonproper contrast all replay from the embedded verifier.

value.rationale: The Public Good index and the nucleolus represent distinct canonical notions—minimal-winning participation and coalition stability—within the same voting-game objects. Their smallest proper-game ordinal separation is therefore a natural structural invariant. The complete first layer has only two weighted symmetry types, one survives removal of dummies, and the nonproper three-player contrast isolates properness as the feature delaying divergence.
